༄༅/ /lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/smin lam dbang gi chu bo bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ smin lam dbang gi chu bo bzhugs so//

'khor 'das mnyam nyid srid zhi'i bdag /rdo rje slob dpon la btud nas// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa yi// smin lam dbang gi chu bo bshad// mtshan nyid kun ldan slob dpon gyis// dam gtsang slob ma 'ga' zhig la// dbang bskur ched du yid 'ong ba'i// gtsang zhing dben pa'i sa phyogs su// phyag dar skyang nul legs byas la// bla sgrub gzhi yi rten rnams bsham// slob dpon g.yas sam mdun dag tu// mtshan ldan bum pa rdzas rgyan bcas// kha rgyan mgul chings ldan pa'i steng*// dung zhal dri ldan gzung thag bsham// dbu rgyan rdo rje dril bu dang*// ma da na dang mu dra dang*| |mig ras me tog kha ṭ+wāṃ dang*// cang te'u la sogs nyer mkho dang*// ba liṃ zar sgong lta bu la// pad+ma brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*// las bum gu gul la sogs dang*// phyi nang gsang mchod ga ṇa'i rdzas// kha na ma tho med par bsham// 'di ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi// sku yi dkyil 'khor dam pa las// blang bya'i dbang chog yin pa'i phyir// dkyil 'khor la sogs dgos pa bskyung*// bgegs la ba liṃ byin byas la// mchod rdzas bsang zhing sbyangs byas la// stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i mchod yon| zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa nam mkha'i khams gang zhing dgyes dgu'i longs spyod dam par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis byin gyis brlabs/ skabs 'dir nang mchod byin rlabs tshogs 'khor ltar bya dgos so// skyabs sems tshad med spyi ltar bsgom// slob dpon gyis ni phyi sgrub dang*// nang gi de kho na nyid sogs// rim gyis bsgom zhing de yi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar dang*/ oṃ gu ru badz+ra ā tsār+ya puṣ+paṃ sogs nyer spyod lnga dang*/

oṃ gu ru badz+ra ā tsār+ya nirmā ṇa saṃ bho ga dharma kā ya tsa turkā ya pa ti sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod dang*/ oṃ gu ru ā tsār+ya tsa turkā ya pa ti a nu rā ga ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ gis gsang mchod dang*/ oṃ gu ru ā tsār+ya tsa turkā ya pa ti ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta shū n+ya dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes de kho nas mchod| gang gi drin dang*/ rje sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa nas/ thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod kyi bar sogs bla ma'i bstod pa gang yang rung bas bstod/ gtor ma bsangs shing rab sbyangs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las bhan+dha rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma 'dod yon lnga ldan zad mi shes pa'i bdud rtsir gyur par dmigs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ gsum brjod/ oṃ gu ru badz+ra ā tsār+ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ bdun gyis gtor ma phul nas gsol ba gdab/ de nas mtshan ldan slob ma ni// zung min nyer lnga man chad dag /mdun du dul bar 'khod pa la// las bum khrus dang me tog bkram// so bdun maṇ+ḍal rgyas par 'bul// de nas slob ma la dri ba// kye bu khyod su yin ci la dga'// zhes slob mas 'di skad gsol/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o// zhes brjod gdong g.yogs me tog gtad// dga' chen khyod kyis gsol ba gdab// dkon mchog gsum gyi rgyun bshags bya// de nas gsang bar gdams pa ni// deng khyod bla ma'i sku'i dkyil 'khor chen por zhugs kyi tshul 'di lta bu ma mthong ba'i mdun du smra bar mi bya ste ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no// zhes brjod rdo rje mgo bor bzhag /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// rdo rje slob dpon dga' chen po// srid zhi'i rgud pa kun sel ba// sku bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal// zhes pa bzhi brjod phyag 'tshal bsam// de nas sngags su sems bskyed pa// slob ma'i snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i dbus su/

don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pas mtshan par bsams la/ slob mas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ zhes brjod/ brtan phyir rdo rje me tog bcas// snying gar bzhag cing 'di skad brjod// oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes pa slob dpon dag gis brjod// rigs lnga'i sdom gzung spyi ltar bya// phan yon sgo nas dam bzhag ni// deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ des na ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gi khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/ khyod kyis kyang 'di dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mdun du smras na dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod rdo rje spyi bor bzhag |nyes dmigs sgo nas dam bzhag ni// oṃ/ de ring rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po// khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes brjod rdo rje snying khar bzhag /gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam bzhag ni// a mṛ ta sbyar chang byin la// 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub 'byung*// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung zhig /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ tod ka ṭha ṭhaḥ zhes sbyin/ slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam bzhag 'di skad brjod/ deng nas bzung ste khyod kyi rdo rje slob dpon nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par mi bya ste/ gal te byas na khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod rdo rje lag tu gtad// ye shes dbab phyir 'di skad gsol// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la/

rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab tu gsol/ gsum brjod slob mas 'di ltar dmigs// slob ma bsam gtan chos bdun bca'// slob ma'i snying khar laṃ las sa dkyil ser po gru bzhi pa/ mgrin par baṃ las chu dkyil dkar po zlum po/ lte bar raṃ las me dkyil dmar po gru gsum pa/ rkang zhabs yaṃ las rlung dkyil ljang gu gzhu lta bu dzhaiḥdrag po me 'bar ba'i me rlung gis bus pas lte ba'i me 'bar bas snying ga'i sa bsros tshe lus drod kyi rang bzhin dang*/ mgrin pa'i chu bskol te sa dkyil la bdud rtsi bab ste bde ba'i rang bzhin dang*/ bde drod gnyis po'i rkyen gyis rang sems yul snang thams cad bde stong du thim par bsam pa'i ngang nas/ slob dpon sems ma rdo rje ma'i/ phyag rgya bu yi snying gar bzhag /oṃ badz+ra ā we sha ya a aḥ /zhes brjod slar yang rol mo bya// gu gul la sogs kyis bdug cing*// oṃ ā we sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya| ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya hūm̐ ha a dzhaiḥ zhes brjod dbab cing brtan pa'i phyir// tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod cing*// rgya gram slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag /slob mas tsam+pa ka la sogs// me tog phreng ba thogs nas cing*// pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes dor mtshan ma brtag pa ni// slob dpon gyi mdzod spu'am gtsug tor la phog na phyag chen/ spyan nam zhal la sngags kyi dngos grub/ sku'i stod smad bar gsum la dngos grub mchog dman bar ma| sku las ring na yun ring mo nas dngos grub 'thob/ phyir lhung na lan gsum gyi bar du bskyar zhing des kyang ma tshud na dngos grub mi 'thob cing*/ skal pa med pas bshags pa sogs la 'bad dgos so// zhes lung bstan/ slar yang me tog spyi bor bzhag /oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes pa bla mas brjod cing sbyin// de nas thur mas mig bsal zhing*// oṃ/ de ring rdo rje 'dzin pa yis// khyod kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// thams cad mig ni dbye bar mdzad// oṃ dzñā na tsak+ṣuḥhūm̐ āḥswā hā/

zhes dbye blta bar bskul ba ni// he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ brjod cing ngo sprod bya ba ni// rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin la/ phung po dang khams skye mched la ni de bzhin gshegs pa dang gshegs ma/ khro bo khro mo'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pa ni 'khor 'das kyi bdag nyid srid gsum brtan g.yo'i gzhi rten du gyur pa yin no// zhes brjod nges pa rnyed du bcug /dngos gzhi dbang bskur rim pa ni// bum gsang sher dbang bzhi pa dang*// so so'i mtha' rten sbyin pa'o// dang po bum dbang zhu ba'i phyir// byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba btab bo// slob ma'i phung khams skye mched dang dbang rdzas rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bum chu dang slob ma'i rnam par shes pa'i phung po mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas rdo rje/ dbu rgyan dang slob ma'i tshor ba'i phung po rin 'byung ser po g.yas rin po che/ rdo rje dang slob ma'i 'du shes kyi phung po 'od dpag med dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ dril bu dang slob ma'i 'du byed kyi phung po don grub ljang gu g.yas rgya gram/ rdor dril dang slob ma'i gzugs kyi phung po rnam snang dkar po g.yas 'khor lo 'dzin cing*/ g.yon rnams dril bu dkur brten pa/ rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud cing dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bsgyings pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis sangs rgyas byang sems nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lhas dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur| chu rgyun gyis lus gang*/ rigs so so'i rgyas btab pa na/ dbang rdzas kyi lha 'od du zhu ba dbang rdzas so so'i rnam par gyur/

slar yang nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar bstsal// de ltar 'di la'ang bstsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba slob dpon gyis btab pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad/ yum rnams kyis dbang rdzas thogs nas dbang bskur/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs skrod/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ rigs kyi lha mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len zhing bzhugs pa la/ slob mas/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi// khyod kyis bdag la dbang skur cig /ces gsol ba btab pa la dbang bskur bar dmigs| bum pa thogs nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ badz+rod ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes mgor bzhag bum chu sbyin/ de ltar dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis lus thams cad gang*/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ dbu rgyan thogs nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid che// ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan pa'i// dbu rgyan dar dpyangs bcas pa'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// oṃ āḥbadz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hoḥ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ zhes mgor sbyin/ bum chu blud/ gong ltar rin 'byung gis rgyas btab nas mchod| rdo rje thogs nas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje yi// dbang gi de ring khyod dbang bskur// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// rab tu grub phyir rdo rje zung*// oṃ āḥbadz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes rdo rje snying mgrin dpral bar reg cing g.yas su gtad/ bum chu sbyin/ gong ltar dpag med kyis rgyas btab la mchod/ dril bu thogs te/ oṃ/ dril bu shes rab dang ldan pa// shin tu dpa' bo nyid dbang bskur// rdo rje'i dam tshig gnas pa khyod// bdag pos dbang bskur rgyas nos shig /oṃ āḥbadz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes g.yon du gtad cing bum chu sbyin/ gong ltar don grub kyis rgyas btab nas mchod/ rdor dril spyi bor bzung nas/ rdo rje'i ming gi dbang bskur bas// rtag pa'i rdo rje rab zhugs nas// mi shigs rdo rje'i ming ldan par// bu khyod de ring dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra satwa twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka taḥ zhes dang*/ rigs lnga las brtsams te skyes pa la yab dang*/ bud med la yum gyi mtshan btags/ bum chu sbyin/ gong ltar rnam snang gis rgyas btab la mchod/ de rnams kyis ma rig pa sogs nyon mongs pa lnga rig pa'i ye shes su gnas bsgyur bas rig pa'i dbang zhes bya'o// zhes bshad/ skabs 'dir rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ni// sbyin phyir byang chub rdo rje yis| |gsol ba btab pas pho mo rnams// rdo rje 'chang du gsal ba la// rdo rje rtse lnga g.yas su gtad// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra satwa hiḥ hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes gtad des kyang sngags brjod cing*/ rdo rje gsor zhing snying khar bzung*/ de nas de la 'di skad brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub nges par bya ba ste rdo rje yongs su mi 'dor ba'o// zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon bdag po'i dbang*// zhu phyir maṇ+ḍal phul nas kyang*// mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba// mgon pos bdag la bstsal nas kyang*// 'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang*// slob dpon phrin las yongs su gsungs// sangs rkyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*/

sdom pa'ang bla med bstsal du gsol// zhes pas gsol ba btab/ slob ma de dbang stegs dbus rdo rje dang g.yas g.yon seṅges bteg pa'i khri'i steng du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du slob ma rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du gsal ba la/ rdo rje g.yas su gtad nas/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje ni// thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog gi dang po'i skyes bu'o/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes g.yas su gtad/ sngags slob mas kyang brjod/ dril bu aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa hoḥ zhes g.yon du gtad cing*/ slob mas sngags brjod/ de nas phyag rgya ni/ yid kyi lus ni brtan bya'i phyir// phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su brjod// gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan// de nyid phyag rgyar rab tu grags// zhes slob mas 'khyud rgya bya/ de la bla mas/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud| |rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba// slob dpon gyi ni dbang du 'gro// rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zung zhig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje'i slob dpon gyur// slob ma'i tshogs kun bsdu bar gyis// de ltar 'khyud pa las byung ba'i bde stong gnyis med kyi ye shes rang rig pa ni slob dpon gyi dbang gi ngo bo yin no// zhes dang dag pa brjod pa ni/ dkyil 'khor zhes ni gang bshad pa// yid ni dkyil 'khor dam pa yin// gzhal med khang zhes bshad pa ni// sems ni gzhal med khang brtsegs 'phags// mdor na phung po lnga rgyal ba// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yin// rdo rje'i skye mched nyid dag kyang*// byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog

/'byung ba bzhi ni yum bzhi'o// zhes gsungs pas/ rang gi phung khams skye mched las gzhan pa'i lha tshogs dang dkyil 'khor phyi rol du yod par mi sems te/ de ni phyin ci log gi 'khrul pa'o// zhes bshad/ brtan byed bum dbang ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rgyal ba rnams kyis bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas dbang bskur bar dmigs nas/ bum pa thogs te/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags bcas kyis dbang bskur/ de ltar dbang bskur bas dri ma dag /chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams slob ma la thim/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs dang me tog 'thor// nyer spyod lngas mchod/ des slob dpon sprul pa'i skur bzhugs pa la phyi sgrub byin rlabs 'byung gnas bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lus kyi dri ma dang nyon mongs pa'i dri ma dag /phung po lnga gnas bsgyur/ ye shes lnga mngon du byas/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /rdo rje rnam lnga'i byin rlabs zhugs/ rigs rnam pa lnga'i dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob rung gi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no// zhes bshad gtang rag maṇ+ḍal dbul/ gsang dbang don du maṇ+ḍal phul// khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis// bdag gis bla med bya ba thob// de phyir gsang ba'i dbang gi ni// mgon po rjes su gzung bar gsol/ */zhes gsum gsol btab gdong bcings nas// slob dpon nang sgrub ltar gsal gdab// yab yum mkha' gsang byin brlabs nas// snyoms 'jug mkha' gsang la bab pa'i// bdud rtsi dkar dmar bu la sbyin// 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis// ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur// byang chub sems ni bzang po yis// bu khyod de ring dbang bskur ro// zhes sbyin slob mas 'di skad brjod// a hoḥm hā su khaṃ/

zhes dang*/ bla ma yab yum gyi byang sems lce thob tu bzhag pa myangs shing bltas pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin de ni gsang dbang gi ngo bo yin/ zhes bshad mig dbye mtha' rten ni// spyod pa'i brtul zhugs 'di ltar sbyin// slob ma nang sgrub bla mar bskyed// kha ṭ+wāṃ la sogs gtad nas kyang*// rus chen rgyan drug dpa' ba ste// kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te'u dung chen bcas// dpa' bos byin pa blangs nas ni// phyi dang nang du yang dag sbyin// brtul zhugs spyod pa'i don du sbyin// rus pa'i rgyan drug rgyal ba drug /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni lha yi sku| |ḍā ma ru ni shes rab stong*// thod pa bde ba chen po ste// tshangs skud rnam par mi rtog pa// de ltar don ldan 'di bcangs nas// brtul zhugs mchog la gnas par gyis// zhes brjod lag g.yas ḍā ru dang*// g.yon du bhan+dha mchan khung ni// g.yon du kha ṭ+wāṃ se ral kha// tshangs skud rus rgyan drug po ni// rang rang gnas sbyin nyer spyod mchod// des slob dpon longs skur bzhugs pa la nang sgrub 'khor 'das rang grol gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /gsung snying po rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku thob rung gi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no// zhes brjod/ gsum pa sher dbang zhu ba'i phyir// maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing 'di skad zhu// bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po| |rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs| |zhes gsol gdong bcings rig ma gtad// dga' ster gnas ster lha mo 'di// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis| |zhes dang slob ma gsang sgrub yab// rig ma yum bskyed mkha' gsang dag

/byin rlabs sbyor tshul dga' ba bzhi// ngos bzung la sogs ji snyed pa// rtsa rlung rdor phreng 'og sgo ltar// rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar bstan par bya// de nas mig phye nyer spyod mchod// mtha' rten rig ma'i brtul zhugs ni// dam sdom dang ldan pa'i rig ma'i lag g.yon dang*/ slob ma'i lag g.yas nas slob dpon gyi g.yon pas bzung ste/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa bu'i spyi bor bzhag nas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas dpang du btsug ste/ 'dir ni khyod rnams dpang po yin// bdag gis 'di la 'di gtad do// zhes dang*/ slob ma la/ gzung ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyi// bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis bshad// 'khor lo rim pa'i sbyor ba yis// bde ba dam pa myong bar gyis// rdo rje'i skyil krung gi sems ni// nor bu nang du chud par blta// brtul zhugs rnams kyi bla ma'i bla// rig ma'i brtul zhugs spyod cig bu// 'gro gsum 'di yang dag pa ste// thabs 'di spangs pa'i sangs rgyas ni// gang du yang ni ma gsungs so// de bas blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod byin pas rig ma de// gos phud skra grol mkha' bstan nas// bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten pa bu spro'am// bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed pa// bu khyod ci ltar dga' ba smros// zhes dris lan du slob ma yis// khu khrag la sogs bza' ba dang*// rtag tu bud med la gus dang*// bha ga la yang 'o bgyid pa// lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro// zhes brjod rig mas 'di skad ces// bha ga bstan nas smra ba ste// e ma bdag gi pad+ma 'di// bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan// ci ste cho ga bzhin bsten na// de yi mdun na bdag gnas so| |sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa'i// bya ba thams cad pad+mas byed// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid du ni yang dag gnas// bhañdza mok+ṣa hoḥ

zhes gsungs pang du byon par bsam| |'og sgo'i dmigs rlung 'khrul 'khor sogs// rdor phreng ji bzhin 'dir bstan to// de nas 'di skad brjod par bya// de ltar dga' ba bzhi lugs 'byung dang lugs ldog gi rnam pa 'pho med du bcings pas/ bde stong zung 'jug 'dzag med lhan skyes kyi ye shes bde ba chen po de ni sher dbang gi ngo bo yin no// zhes bshad nyer spyod lngas mchod nas/ des bla ma chos skur bzhugs pa la gsang sgrub ye shes rgya mtsho shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag /rtsa rlung rdo rje'i phreng ba nyams su blang ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob rung gi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no| |zhes brjod gtang rag maṇ+ḍal dbul// tshig dbang don du maṇ+ḍal dang*// khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis// gtso bo dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bka' drin gyis ni bskyang du gsol// zhes gsol gdong bcings slob ma rnams// bsam gtan chos bdun bcas nas cing*// zab cing rgya che'i rtogs pa skyed// ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs// rdul bral mtha' ster zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes pa'i don gyi phyag rgya chen po blo 'das bsam du med pa'i don yin no// zhes bshad mig bsal mtha' rten ni// slob dpon sprul sku'i cha lugs kyis| |'grengs te lag g.yas rdo rje dang*// bcas te mi 'jigs phyag rgya dang*// g.yon pa dril bcas khu tshur gyis// chos gos grwa ni glang po yi// rna ba lta bu zung nu ma// g.yon thad bzung nas 'di skad brjod// oṃ/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir// srid dang ngan 'gro rnams las bton// kyai dpal zhes bos nas sngar gsang mtshan btags pa brjod la/

zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa grub pas sa gsum gyi bdag por 'gyur ro// zhes dang lag g.yas steng du bcang*// g.yon pas dril 'khrol 'di skad do// gang ngas lung bstan pa 'di la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas mgrin gcig tu byang chub chen por lung ston par mdzad pa ni phyag rgya dang sngags 'di nyid kyi mthu yin no// zhes brjod slob mar gdugs phub nas// dkyil 'khor bskor zhing slar yang ni// gdugs bzhag slob mar 'di skad gsol// rgyud rnams 'dzin par gyur pa yi// slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags// zhes pas slob ma lhar phul nas// slar yang dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod ni// da ni khyod rnams dkyil 'khor gyi// slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// lha rnams dag kyang dgongs par 'gyur// sems can kun la brtse don du// khyod kyis dkyil 'khor go cha bzhin// rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya// sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor// mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi// dkyil 'khor mthong zhing zhugs pas na// sdig pa kun las rnam par grol// de ring khyod rnams bde bar gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// phyin chad 'chi ba khyod la med// srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das// srid pa shin tu mtha' grub pa// sangs rgyas rdo rje can kun gyis// de ring tshe ldan dbang bskur ro// khams gsum kun gyi rgyal srid che'i// bdag po nyid du khyod nges so| |'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum na ni gzhan med do// de bas 'dod la chags bral ba// khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o// 'dod pa kun la spyod pa khyod// gang la'ang 'jigs med spyad par gyis// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bza' bya// 'di las gzhan yang dam tshig srungs// srog chags bsad par mi bya zhing*// bud med rin chen spang mi bya// slob dpon spang bar mi bya ste// dam tshig shin tu 'da' bar dka'// shes rab thabs kyi bsam pa yis// mi bya cung zad yod ma yin// ma 'jigs khyod la sdig pa med// de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung ji bzhin// 'di ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis// rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde ster nyid du gyis// 'gro ba bde ba nyung las rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyod rnams phyin par 'gyu+ur/

gzhan yang gang dag cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du dbang bskur ba la dge ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis sdug pa'i bu dang 'dra ba thugs dang bas yang dag pa dgongs par mdzad pa 'di ni chos nyid yin no// zhes brjod nyer spyod lngas mchod nas// go ba 'di skad bskyed par bya// des bla ma ngo bo nyid kyi skur bzhugs pa la de kho na nyid du sgrub pa spros bral mthar phyin tshig gi dbang bskur ba thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag */rdzogs rim mnyam yangs mtha' bral bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob rung gi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no// zhes bshad slob mas dam bsrung phyir// gtso bos ji ltar sogs brjod cing*// gtang rag maṇ+ḍal rgyas par 'bul// tshogs kyi dga' ston bya ba ni// sha zan la sogs bza' ba'i tshogs// thabs kyi rdzas rnams g.yas su bzhag /ma da na sogs btung ba'i tshogs// shes rab rdzas rnams g.yon du bzhag /raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsregs sbyangs bkru+us// bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i dang las rlung me thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ bhan+dha yangs pa'i nang du tshogs kyi dngos po rnams sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin gyi steng du rigs lnga yab yum bcu'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ 'og gi rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros rdzas rnams khol ba'i rlangs pa las/ steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ā di kā di'i mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs snod bcud kyi bcud thams cad bkug rdzas la thim/ dbyangs gsal zla ba dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba bdud rtsir thim pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ gsum brjod tshogs mgron spyan drang ba/ hūm̐ hūm̐ */ chos dbyings bde chen gzhal yas nas// rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa'i tshogs// ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren na// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// 'og min gnas mchog gzhal yas nas// yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs// ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren na// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// gnas yul dag pa'i gzhal yas nas// ma sring mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro'i tshogs// ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren na// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// phyogs bcu'i dur khrod gzhal yas nas// chos srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren na/

mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// zhes dang tshogs phud bcad pa la| ma da na sgron 'bul ba ni/ hoḥ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// srung ma chos skyong 'khor bcas la// shes rab chen po ma da na// thabs kyi bza' ba sna tshogs pa// ba la maṃ sa khur ba sogs| |sna tshogs 'dod dgu'i longs spyod tshogs// rnam bzhi'i mgron rnams la 'bul gyi// dgyes pa chen pos bzhes nas kyang*// mchog thun dngos grub bstsal du gsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ zhes dbul slob dpon slob mar bcas// phal pa'i spyod min bag ldan pas// tshogs kyi 'khor lo la rol ba'i// lhag ma yongs bsdus slob dpon gyi// kha chu bran la 'di skad do// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ gsum dang a kā ro gsum brjod// oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bhak+ṣa bh+yaḥswā hā/ zhes pas lhag sbyin yo byad bsdu// las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya// de ltar lam zab bla sgrub kyi/ /smin lam dbang gi chu bo zhes/ /rgyud sde kun dang mthun pa la/ /kun la ltos mi dgos pa 'di/ /bla sgrub smin byed la dgongs nas/ /rat+na shrī'i gsung bzhin du// chos kyi grags pas 'dir bris kyi// dge bas byang chub thob phyir bsngo// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
